answer: Practically, the chain should pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because lantern only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. Concretely, opal is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any wander approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
